summary: Defines an extension to the Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) to support the Identifier-Locator Network Protocol for IPv4 (ILNPv4). It comes from the IRTF Routing Research Group and defines an Experimental Protocol.

eli5.summary: ARP is how a computer asks who has this address so it can deliver mail. This memo teaches that question a few new tricks needed by ILNP. It is only an experiment.
